stories.title: Ohio Democratic candidate Amy Acton condemns opponent's ad featuring estranged mother
stories.summary: Amy Acton, the Democratic candidate for Ohio governor, called a campaign advertisement by her Republican opponent despicable. The ad features Acton's estranged mother, Donna Arthur, accusing Acton of lying her entire life. The spot does not mention that Arthur’s husband was charged with raping Acton as a child and that Acton and her brother were subsequently removed from Arthur’s custody.
stories.why: It shows how personal family histories are used in political attacks, which can influence voter perceptions.

stories.title: France extends curfew in Paris and bans protests in Marseille and Lyon after weekend riots
stories.summary: Paris is extending a partial curfew that restricts movement in parts of the city until Monday, while Marseille and Lyon have imposed a total ban on protests for the weekend. The Louvre, Orsay and Picasso museums in Paris will be closed on Saturday. The measures follow large protests over the cost of living and school conditions that escalated into riots and looting, damaging businesses and historic buildings.
stories.why: The restrictions are intended to curb further violence and protect public safety amid the unrest.
stories.previousTitle: France extends Paris curfew and bans protests in Marseille and Lyon
stories.previousSummary: Paris will keep a partial curfew in parts of the city until Monday, while Marseille and Lyon have imposed a total ban on protests for the weekend. The Louvre, Orsay and Picasso museums will be closed on Saturday as authorities anticipate further demonstrations. The measures follow weekend riots and looting that damaged businesses and historic buildings after protests over the cost of living and school conditions.

stories.title: Premature twins struggle to survive after fleeing Houthi advance in Yemen’s Kahboub mountains
stories.summary: Seven‑week‑old twins Raghad Hassan and Raad, born prematurely, have been fighting for survival as fighting intensified in Yemen’s civil war. When Houthi forces reached their village in the Kahboub mountains, their family of seven fled on foot with only blankets. During the walk the twins grew weaker, with worsening vomiting and diarrhoea, their mother Lina said.
stories.why: The case illustrates the severe humanitarian impact of the Yemen conflict on infants and displaced families.
stories.previousTitle: Premature twins displaced from Yemen village amid Houthi attack
stories.previousSummary: Twins Raghad Hassan and her brother Raad were born premature just seven weeks ago. When Houthis reached their village in the Kahboub mountains, their family of seven fled amid bombs, missiles, and drone attacks, walking three days before being given a a lift to Aden.

stories.title: RBI focuses on interest‑rate gap with G7 as inflation risks rise
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is monitoring the interest‑rate gap with major G7 economies while assessing rising inflation and input‑cost pressures. Recent GDP data show resilience, supported by strong private consumption and exports. YES Bank forecasts a cumulative RBI policy‑rate increase of 50 basis points.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: RBI asks banks, payment firms to forensically clear tech environments in case of a data breach
stories.summary: The RBI has asked financial entities to remove management and administrative interfaces from public internet access, enforce multi-factor authentication for administrative access, and restrict access to cloud and backend systems on a least-privilege basis. The RBI issued the advisory on October 19, shortly after CERT-In warned about the growing use of artificial intelligence agents to carry out cyberattacks.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up
stories.summary: OpenAI made its Decisions API model widely available to users for the first time, entering the market for fast, cheap intelligence that recently made TypeSafe, a startup founded by a former researcher at the frontier lab, a $7.6 billion company . TypeSafe’s Jev model created a category for deep learning models that act as super classifiers: Given a set of options, they can quickly make choices and offer a confidence rating in their decision.
stories.why: This matters because it could change AI capabilities, costs, adoption, regulation or competitive positioning.
stories.previousTitle: OpenAI makes Decisions API widely available
stories.previousSummary: OpenAI released its Decisions API to all customers, repurposing the ChatGPT Luna model to deliver faster, lower‑cost inference. The API cuts typical response times from one‑to‑three seconds to about 100‑180 ms and adds voice and visual modalities, with latency optimizations targeting inference resources worldwide. The launch follows TypeSafe’s Jev model, which created a market for rapid “super‑classifier” decision systems.

stories.title: India-EU trade deal could become operational in early-2027, Piyush Goyal says
stories.summary: India's trade minister Piyush Goyal announced that the EU FTA is expected to be signed soon. The deal aims to boost market access and bilateral trade between India and the EU significantly.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.
